scenario: Bindings must be unique within a rule per LGRA.13.6. Declaring two patterns that bind the same name in the same rule rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DUPLICATE_BINDING. Pin: two patterns both binding `x` — even on different schema types — reject.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema B scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    A x where x.v > 0
    B x
